transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Festival Sustainability Coordinator. Before we get into the details, I want to make sure we follow our standard pre-event process — I need to hear from the electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility leads on any required changes before I can approve the operating package. We've got the Saturday evening closing concert at Riverside Park coming up, and the draft package currently includes a diesel generator, mixed-waste bins, shuttle pickup at the West Gate every 30 minutes, and an accessible audience route from the main entrance. Who'd like to start with their review?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a major electrical issue. During this week's technical test, I measured the planned sound and lighting load and confirmed that the park service can supply only 125 amps, while the draft package requires 200 amps. The good news is that a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load — but I haven't yet added its load schedule to the operations packet. We'll need to replace the diesel generator with the battery trailer and update the package accordingly.

transcript.text: I have a permitting update. I confirmed with the city permit office yesterday that the event permit requires all serviceware to be compostable and requires three-stream waste stations for food and beverage areas. I haven't yet copied this condition into the festival's sustainability checklist, but it's a binding permit requirement. This means the current draft package's mixed-waste bins will need to be replaced with three-stream waste stations in the food and beverage areas.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a transport update. I confirmed with the transit authority this morning that the road-closure approval permits shuttle pickup only at the East Gate, with departures every 15 minutes from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The current transport sheet still shows the West Gate and 30-minute departures, so we'll need to update the operating package to reflect the East Gate location and the 15-minute departure schedule.

transcript.text: I have an accessibility update. My accessibility inspection found that the accessible audience route must begin at the South Entrance and maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters to the raised viewing platform. The current site map still routes guests from the main entrance and does not record the measured width, so the operating package will need to be updated to reflect the South Entrance starting point and the 1.8-meter clear width requirement.
